heading: Pay your deposit
subheading: Secure your group reservation with a deposit. Your reference is shown below, please keep it for your records.
successBody: Thank you! We've recorded your deposit under reference {ref}. Our team will be in touch shortly.
unconfirmedBody: Your payment went through with PayPal, but we couldn't confirm it on our side just yet. Please don't pay again. Our team will confirm it shortly (reference {ref}).
invalidBody: Please check that you opened the full link we sent you, or contact us and we'll send a new one.
expiredBody: Please contact us and we'll send you a new one.
